$comment: The residue contract (design-overhaul P1): what must be GONE from a generated app before it may be called done. Read server-side from TEMPLATES_DIR by readResidueContract() — never copied into projects, so the builder cannot edit its own audit. 'hard' findings block done; 'soft' findings should be fixed or overridden with a stated reason. Covers BOTH the fresh scaffold's data-placeholder markers and legacy projects that still carry the old demo.

hard.why: the starter demo directory (legacy scaffold) — delete it entirely
hard.fix: Delete src/demo/ and remove every '@/demo/' import.

hard.why: App still imports the demo — the entry point was never rewired to your app
hard.fix: Rewrite src/App.tsx: replace demo imports and the demo view union with your app's views.

hard.why: the STARTER TEMPLATE's brand, still present alongside the demo this project was copied from
hard.fix: Rename it to this app's own name. (Only reported because src/demo or an @/demo import is also present — Meridian is an ordinary word, and a project that merely chose it as a product name is not residue.)

hard.why: the demo's nav label, still present alongside the demo this project was copied from
hard.fix: Replace the nav links with this app's real views.

hard.why: a scaffold placeholder was never replaced with real app content
hard.fix: Replace the marked element (brand or scaffold panel) with your app's real content and REMOVE the data-placeholder attribute.

hard.why: the default page title — the browser tab must show the app's name
hard.fix: Edit index.html's <title> to the app's name.

soft.fix: Set package.json name to a kebab-case app name (cosmetic — override with a reason if time-boxed).
